rationale: The porch camera reports 7% battery with a low-battery warning logged 3 days ago, and it went offline yesterday. Signal strength is healthy (-64 dBm), firmware is current, and the base station is online with no fault codes, so the outage is attributable to the depleted battery rather than a network or hardware fault.

repair_steps: Advise customer to replace the battery in the Porch Cam with a new CR123A battery.
Confirm the camera is powered on and reconnects to the base station after battery replacement.
If the camera does not come online, perform a factory reset by holding the reset button for 10 seconds and re-pair it with the base station.
output.customer_reply: Thank you for contacting support. The issue with your Porch Cam is due to a depleted battery (7% charge). Please replace the battery with a new CR123A battery. After replacement, the camera should reconnect automatically. If it does not, press and hold the reset button for 10 seconds and re-pair it with the base station. If you need further assistance, let us know.

complaint: Porch camera offline. It said low battery a few days ago, so maybe that's all it is. I don't have much time to deal with this, so please just tell me what to do or send me whatever part I need and I'll swap it myself this weekend.
